whatIsIt: The **LUMIA Glow Drop Serum** is a Korean hydrating serum for dull, tired-looking skin, in a 30ml dropper bottle.
A water-light gel texture that sinks in fast instead of sitting on top of your skin.
Niacinamide: helps the look of uneven tone
Hyaluronic Acid: helps skin feel plump and hydrated
howToUse: Use morning and night before moisturizer.
mainIdea: A close-up, texture-driven TikTok showcasing LUMIA's water-light glow serum.
It walks through the dropper, the texture on skin and the instant glow.
caption:
wait why does my skin look like this 😳
this water-light serum sinks in instantly
grab it on tiktok shop 💧
music:
Anything bright and upbeat.
Avoid trending audio with harsh edits.
videoType: Vertical, 9:16, 1080x1920 or higher. 20–30 seconds. Bright lighting.

steps.title: Step 1 (HOOK): The Dropper Drip
action: Start **mid-action**, squeezing the dropper over your cheek.
subtitle: one drop = glass skin?

steps.title: Texture Close-Up
action: Rub a drop between two fingers.
visual: This should be the **hero product shot**.
subtitle: water-light → no sticky finish

steps.title: Pat It In
action: Pat the serum into both cheeks.
visual: Close-up of your face in bright light.
subtitle: pat pat pat

steps.title: Final Look + CTA
action: Hold the bottle next to your face.
visual: Make sure the **LUMIA logo** is visible.
subtitle: glow unlocked ✨

stepNotes.text: Do not squeeze the dropper bulb too hard — it spills.
